answer_1.quote: Query rewrite is an approach that converts a context-dependent user query into a self-contained utterance so that it can be understood and executed independent of previous dialogue context.

answer_2.quote: The standard BLEU between the generated and the target sentences are reported. In addition, to highlight the quality of the rewritten parts in generated sentences, following the post-processing in , we measure an F1 score calculated by comparing machine-generated words with ground truth words for only the ellipsis / co-reference part of user utterances. We also report the percentage of all referents in ground-truth coreference links that were successfully generated in the query rewrite, denoted as reference match (RM).
